name: Falling Power Attack (Combat)
body:
You use the momentum of your fall to cause devastating damage to your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When falling as part of an attack, you may use Power Attack to reduce the damage you suffer by 2d6 and increase the damage of your attack by 2d6.
